title: Northstar renewal variant: Sam pauses everything for a possible PHI incident; the candidate waits until his stated date

based_on.change: Northstar cp4 recast as the renewal of the Lakeside intake contract (motion renewal), plus an invented 09-25 email from Sam: a possible PHI incident at Lakeside; hold the invite and the paperwork until Oct 2.

fields.decision_process: Sam Okafor (Information Security Lead) owns the evaluation, including the BAA; Elena Vasquez stepped back from the day-to-day and joins for final sign-off; Grace Liu approves budget on Elena's recommendation

blockers.text: Security sign-off by Sam Okafor's team before any clinic goes live (intake forms carry PHI; BAA required)
Possible PHI incident at Lakeside under investigation by Northstar compliance

fields.next_milestone: Sam reports the compliance outcome by October 2

recent_changes.summary: Sam paused everything: possible PHI incident at Lakeside; hold the review invite and renewal paperwork; he will come back by Oct 2.

trigger.text:
Dana - we're investigating a misrouted intake form at Lakeside that may involve PHI. Please hold the review invite and any renewal paperwork; no need to reply. Our compliance team will contact your security team directly, and I'll come back to you by Friday October 2.
Sam

commitments.text: Send Sam Okafor an invite for the security review on Sep 29 or Sep 30

timeline_facts.stated_timing: Sam: hold everything until Fri Oct 2

candidate_action.reason: Sam asked us to hold the invite and the paperwork and not to reply; he returns by Oct 2.

evidence_refs.quote: Please hold the review invite and any renewal paperwork; no need to reply.

expected.label: WAIT
expected.rationale: The customer explicitly asked for no reply and a hold until Oct 2.
Respects a possible PHI incident by not pushing anything into it.

expected.label: TOO_EARLY
expected.rationale: Any outreach before Sam's Oct 2 date would be too early.
The open invite commitment is suspended by the customer's own request, not dropped.
expected.debate_note: Some reviewers would want the invite commitment explicitly marked deferred in CRM (an internal note) rather than a bare wait.

notes: Hard: an open commitment and a renewal clock both pull toward acting; the customer's instruction wins.
